# Synthetic jet numeric ledger

Every number below is deliberately chosen mathematical TEST DATA, authorized by the owner for T9. None estimates a real engine or aircraft. Existing aerodynamic/mass values are copied from the original synthetic fixture. Engine samples are polynomial test values, not a thermodynamic model.

With m=Mach, h=geometric metres, t=dimensionless throttle, test thrust = 100t + 20m + .01h + 50mt + .02ht + .001hm + .003hmt; test fuel flow = .01 + .2t + .03m + .00001h + .04mt + .00002ht + .000003hm + .000004hmt. Every coefficient in these generating expressions is itself a SYNTHETIC TEST VALUE.
